title: Device run with steps and expected results
subtitle: A phone checklist: tags, per-item steps, expected results

sections.title: What the tester confirms on the device
sections.intro:
Use a clean device signed in to the test account.

- Pairing and sync are new in this branch.
- The unit tests cover the parsers, not the radio.

groups.title: Pairing
groups.intro: Do these in order: each one needs the one before it.

items.text: Pair the device with the `demo` hub
steps: Hold the hub button for 3 seconds
Wait for the hub light to turn steady
items.expect: the hub light is green and the screen says Paired

items.text: A change made offline reaches the hub
items.expect: the new name shows on the hub within 10 seconds

items.text: A long list scrolls without a stall

sections.onFail: Leave the box unticked and note the step, what you saw and what you expected.
